rv.q: But with “Twihard,” they captured something magical, a hilarious, loving, musically gorgeous tribute and riff to a series that means a lot to a lot of people.
Schaefer and Rasmussen's work here sparkles, and Otherworld's production is flawless (give or take a tree falling down onstage).
It has been a long time since I've seen a show that has taken me completely by surprise.
For diehard fans, Twihard! A Twilight Musical Parody is a knockout comedy with dazzling, energetic performances and boisterous music.
This is the one that is fun to watch ( even for an old geezer like me).

cn.t: Critics find this satirical musical a sparkling comic treat that successfully skewers the Twilight saga, with strong performances and an eclectic soundtrack that delights fans and newcomers alike.
